classification: STATIC code generation inventory only; no benchmark, profile capture, candidate or population
entry_frame_method: Contiguous function-entry prefix only; stops at first ordinary instruction. Not a CFG/stack-depth proof. Cold path frames remain counted only among stack-related instructions.
limitations: Instruction lines are static size, not retired instructions, cycles or speed
Separate binary layout/call/inlining decisions are compiler consequences of the truthful adapter contract
Not comparable to other benchmark binaries or historical006 code sizes
No elapsed fields or PC counts are used
backend: Inherited Codex/GPT-6 family; exact serving model/token/currency cost unknown
